description: Control run for H1.4.1, and the epoch-slope point for H1. Start from A1a (E001 tip) and change only the epoch count, from 8.5 to 8.0. Scale the LR and lookahead/EMA schedule to the new total step count the same way the recipe already does. Leave everything else byte-identical. Log the per-seed accuracies.
